rows.commentary: 1.5: Sachitha Jayatilake tosses it up, and Habibur Rahman Sohan dispatches it cleanly over deep extra cover for a maximum.
1.6: Sachitha Jayatilake slides one through, driven hard by Habibur Rahman Sohan toward long-off for a boundary.
2.1: Wijesinghe steams in, and Sabbir Rahman launches it high over deep mid-wicket to pump fresh momentum into the ongoing partnership.
2.2: Wijesinghe finds the slot again, and Sabbir Rahman lofts it gracefully over extra cover into the crowd.
2.3: Wijesinghe drifts onto the pads, flicked expertly by Sabbir Rahman away to the deep mid-wicket fence.
2.4: Wijesinghe keeps it tidy, nudged by Sabbir Rahman into the mid-wicket region for a single.
2.5: Dot ball from Wijesinghe to Habibur Rahman Sohan.
2.6: Dot ball from Wijesinghe to Habibur Rahman Sohan.
3.1: Ravindu Fernando is greeted harshly as Sabbir Rahman deposits the delivery deep over mid-wicket for six runs.
3.2: Ravindu Fernando drops short, punished instantly by Sabbir Rahman who pulls it powerfully to the deep mid-wicket boundary.
3.3: Ravindu Fernando bowls a wide to Sabbir Rahman.
3.3: Ravindu Fernando flights it up, and Sabbir Rahman clears his front leg to dispatch it over long-on.
3.4: Ravindu Fernando fires it in, pushed securely toward mid-wicket by Sabbir Rahman to rotate the strike.
3.5: Ravindu Fernando overpitches, and Habibur Rahman Sohan capitalizes by smashing it deep over mid-wicket.
3.6: Ravindu Fernando delivers the final ball of the sequence, carved magnificently by Habibur Rahman Sohan through extra cover for six.
4.1: Vishen Halambage drops it on a length and Sabbir Rahman works it away to mid-wicket for a single.
4.2: Vishen Halambage serves it up and Habibur Rahman Sohan drives firmly out to deep extra cover to rotate the strike.
3.6: Mrittunjoy Chowdhury delivers to Wijesinghe, who carves it away to deep extra cover for a boundary.
4.1: Chowdhury Md Rizwan bowls a wide to Muditha Lakshan.
4.1: Wide from Chowdhury Md Rizwan to Muditha Lakshan.
4.1: Chowdhury Md Rizwan strikes as Muditha Lakshan falls, caught by Ahrar Amin for a duck off the first ball.
4.2: Chowdhury Md Rizwan bowls a wide to Vishen Halambage.
4.2: Chowdhury Md Rizwan is greeted by Vishen Halambage with a sharp stroke racing away to backward square leg for four.
4.3: Vishen Halambage connects cleanly against Chowdhury Md Rizwan, launching the ball all the way over long-on for a maximum.
4.4: Chowdhury Md Rizwan feels the pressure as Vishen Halambage deposits another one into the mid-wicket stands for six.
4.5: Chowdhury Md Rizwan bowls a wide to Vishen Halambage.
4.5: Dot ball from Chowdhury Md Rizwan to Vishen Halambage.
4.6: Vishen Halambage punishes Chowdhury Md Rizwan once more, clearing deep mid-wicket for yet another massive six.
5.1: Mrittunjoy Chowdhury bowls a wide to Wijesinghe.
5.1: Mrittunjoy Chowdhury takes matters into his own hands, claiming Wijesinghe caught and bowled after a brisk sixteen.
5.2: Mrittunjoy Chowdhury watches helplessly as Vishen Halambage sends the delivery soaring over deep mid-wicket for six.
